features.name: any_long_parenthetical_in_counterargument
features.definition: Does at least one counter-argument comment contain a parenthetical aside of 20 or more characters?
features.spec: Parse OC_comments with json.loads into a list of strings; malformed/missing -> null; empty list -> 0. For each comment, find matches of regex r'\(([^()]*)\)' (innermost parentheses, no nesting); a match counts if len(inner text) >= 20 characters (inner text between the parentheses, including spaces, no stripping). Return 1 if any comment has at least one such match, else 0. Purely mechanical; no semantic filtering; URLs in markdown links like [text](url) are matched too unless the match is immediately preceded by ']' (those are excluded).

h0: any_long_parenthetical_in_counterargument has no association with delta.
h1: Discussions with at least one counter-argument containing a long (20+ character) parenthetical aside are more likely to have delta=1.
note: Persuasiveness is operationalized as the dataset outcome delta (OP changed view); association only. "Counter-arguments with" interpreted as any comment in the row having such an aside (alternatives: share or count). Parentheses are detected mechanically; unbalanced or nested parentheses are missed, and markdown link URLs are excluded. Comment text may contain outcome announcements or later edits; timing is unknown, and list order is not chronology.
